data.title: 2B · 废墟倾塌高架的白之契约持刃
data.description: 【2B · 废墟倾塌高架的白之契约持刃】被巨树与青苔彻底吞噬的人类废墟都市高架桥断崖边，狂风猎猎作响。2B 屹立在倾塌的钢筋混凝土边缘，黑色眼罩遮挡着视线却掩盖不住周身的肃杀剑意。纯白太刀「白之契约」在半空悬浮蓄势待发，哥特战斗裙的高开叉裙摆随风翻涌，露出纯白紧身连体衣与修长结实的黑皮靴大腿——「全机体……歼灭指令确认。」
data.location: 废墟都市断裂高架公路边缘悬崖
data.action: 手按虚空悬浮长刀独立断桥，海风吹卷羽毛裙摆与银白短发，英姿冷峻肃杀
data.lighting: 废墟大楼林立间穿透的冷冽日光与长刀白刃冷白寒芒
data.camera: dynamic low angle, full body wide shot, sweeping post-apocalyptic scale
data.promptProse: 2B stands on the broken reinforced-concrete highway edge in her black embroidered YoRHa dress and thigh-high boots, blindfold in place as Virtuous Contract floats ready beside her. The low full-body wide view carries fractured beams beneath her toward moss-covered towers and enormous trees. Cold sunlight between buildings catches white embroidery and the katana edge, leaving the ravaged highway's underside shaded beneath the wind-lifted skirt.
